arabic text: SHAAM MAIN MEHSHAR BAPA HAI AMAAN HAYE AMAAN
english translation text: Zahra's daughter is without a veil—alas, alas! A Judgement Day has arisen in Shaam.

arabic text: BHEER HAI NA MAHRAMON KI AUR BEY CHADAR SAFAR\nKUND KHANJAR SE NAHI KAM SHAAM WALON KI NAZAR\nQATL-E-ZAINAB HO RAHA HAI AMAAN HAYE AMAAN
english translation text: There is a crowd of strangers, and the journey is without chadar.\nThe gaze of Shaam's people is no less than a blunt dagger.\nZainab is being killed—alas, alas!

arabic text: TAAZIYAANE AUR PATHAR HAIN BARASTE GAAM GAAM\nLAKE ANGARAY CHATON SE PHENKTE HAIN AHLE SHAAM\nHAR QADAM PAR KARBALA HAI AMAAN HAYE AMAAN
english translation text: Whips and stones rain at every step.\nThe people of Shaam bring embers and throw them from the rooftops.\nAt every step is another Karbala—alas, alas!

arabic text: AYAT-E-TATHEER HAI NOHA KUNAN BAZAAR MAIN\nALHAFEEDH O AMAAN SAYDANIYAN BAZAAR MAIN\nNANGE SAR AAL-E-ABA HAI AMAAN HAYE AMAAN
english translation text: The verse of purification recites lament within the marketplace.\nProtection, O God—the Sayyid ladies are in the marketplace.\nThe family of the cloak stands bareheaded—alas, alas!

arabic text: TERAH ZARBEIN DEKHNE SE BHI ZIYADA HAI MUHAAL\nSHAH NE NOK-E-SINAA SE DEKH KAR ZAINAB KA HAAL\nBAND AANKHON KO KIYA HAI AMAAN HAYE AMAAN
english translation text: More unbearable than witnessing thirteen blows:\nfrom the spear-point, the King saw Zainab's condition\nand closed his eyes—alas, alas!

arabic text: KHAK PAR GIR JATA HAI ABBAS KA SAR BAAR NAAR\nKIUN SHARAABI KI ZABAAN-E-BEY HAYA PAR BAAR BAAR\nNAAM-E-ZAINAB AA RAHA HAI AMAAN HAYE AMAAN
english translation text: Abbas's head repeatedly falls from the spear to the dust.\nWhy does Zainab's name repeatedly come\nfrom the drunkard's shameless tongue? Alas, alas!

arabic text: KAISAY ZINDA REH SAKE GI ZULM KE TOOFAN MAIN\nMAR HI JAYE GI SAKINAH SHAAM KE ZINDAAN MAIN\nROSHNI HAI NA HAWA HAI AMAAN HAYE AMAAN
english translation text: How can she remain alive within this storm of oppression?\nSakina will surely die in Shaam's prison.\nThere is neither light nor air—alas, alas!

arabic text: AYE HASAN MAJLIS MAIN GAR ROTE HAIN SAARE MAATAMI\nSUN KE YEH NOOHA KAREEM ABBAS KA JANNAT MAIN BHI\nMEHWE-E-MAATAM SYEDA HAI AMAAN HAYE AMAAN
english translation text: O Hasan, if every mourner weeps within the majlis,\nhearing this lament, Karim, even in Paradise\nAbbas and the Sayyida are absorbed in matam—alas, alas!
